name: New Jersey
title: New Jersey Rebate Calculator 2026: PSE&G, JCP&L and Atlantic City Electric Heat Pump Rebates
h1: New Jersey Rebate Calculator 2026: What Your Utility Pays
desc: Free New Jersey rebate calculator for PSE&G, JCP&L and Atlantic City Electric customers. Heat pump, water heater, thermostat, battery and EV rebates, with the official source for every amount.
intro: New Jersey rebates come from your electric utility and from a few state programs. This calculator shows what PSE&G, JCP&L and Atlantic City Electric pay today.
short: New Jersey has no one statewide heat pump rebate. Your electric utility pays it. PSE&G, JCP&L and Atlantic City Electric each pay up to $10,000 when a cold climate heat pump replaces a gas, oil or propane heating system, and smaller amounts for a standard heat pump, a heat pump water heater and a smart thermostat. PSE&G also pays up to $5,000 for a home battery. The federal tax credits ended after 2025.
faq: Is there a heat pump rebate in New Jersey?

Yes, from your electric utility. PSE&G, JCP&L and Atlantic City Electric all pay up to $10,000 (more for income-qualified homes) when a cold climate heat pump replaces gas, oil or propane heat. A standard heat pump earns $300 to $1,000 depending on the utility and efficiency.

Look at the top of your electric bill. PSE&G serves much of northern and central New Jersey, including Newark and Jersey City. JCP&L serves much of the central and shore area, including Toms River. Atlantic City Electric serves the southern part of the state, including Atlantic City.
Is there a New Jersey solar rebate?

There is no cash rebate. New Jersey pays solar owners credits for the power they make (about $77 per megawatt-hour for registrations from July 27, 2026), plus net metering and a property tax exemption.
Are the federal tax credits still available?
No. The 25C and 25D credits ended for spending after December 31, 2025.

programs.name: PSE&G air source heat pump instant rebate
programs.rules: $300 or $450 by efficiency tier, $600 for a cold climate model. Participating contractor puts it on your invoice.

programs.name: PSE&G Clean Heat (replace gas, oil or propane heat)
programs.rules: Lesser of $10,000 or 50% of the project ($12,000 or 60% if income-qualified). Cold climate heat pump sized for the whole home. Extra for decommissioning and re-ducting.

programs.name: PSE&G heat pump water heater
programs.rules: $750 when it replaces a gas or oil water heater, $450 on the standard HVAC list. Ask your contractor which line applies.

programs.name: PSE&G smart thermostat
programs.rules: Up to $100 after purchase, or free from a Whole Home Energy Assessment.

programs.name: PSE&G GridSmart Battery
programs.rules: Tesla Powerwall 3, Enphase 10C or Enphase 5P only. New installs, no leases. You let PSE&G use the battery up to 100 times a year.

programs.name: PSE&G EV home charger
programs.rules: ENERGY STAR Level 2 smart charger. Up to $5,000 more can reduce a required deposit for utility work.

programs.name: PSE&G Home Weatherization
programs.rules: Income between 250% and 400% of poverty, a moderate-income area, NJ SHARES or an overburdened community. Insulation, air sealing and more at no cost.

programs.name: JCP&L air source heat pump
programs.rules: ENERGY STAR heat pump installed as a matched set. Apply within 120 days of purchase.

programs.name: JCP&L Clean Comfort (replace gas, oil or propane heat)
programs.rules: Lesser of $10,000 or 50% of the project ($12,000 or 60% for moderate income). Existing single-family homes. Installed from February 1, 2026 through June 30, 2027.

programs.name: JCP&L heat pump water heater
programs.rules: ENERGY STAR certified. Apply within 120 days of purchase.

programs.name: JCP&L smart thermostat
programs.rules: ENERGY STAR smart thermostat, $100 per unit.

programs.name: JCP&L Whole Home Energy Solutions
programs.rules: $2,000 plus $200 for each point of modeled savings above 5%, up to $7,500 and 50% of cost. Air sealing before insulation.

programs.name: Atlantic City Electric heat pump
programs.rules: $500 or $750 by tier, $750 for a ductless mini-split, $2,000 for a cold climate model (limited time through June 30, 2027). Extra $300 for low- to moderate-income homes.

programs.name: Atlantic City Electric electrification (replace gas, oil or propane heat)
programs.rules: Up to $10,000 or 50% of project costs for a full switch with a cold climate heat pump. Contractor applies within 90 days of purchase.

programs.name: Atlantic City Electric heat pump water heater
programs.rules: ENERGY STAR certified heat pump water heater.

programs.name: Atlantic City Electric smart thermostat
programs.rules: $150 for an ENERGY STAR smart thermostat installed with an HVAC job (limited time through June 30, 2027). Energy Wise Rewards adds up to $100.

programs.name: Comfort Partners (free upgrades)
programs.rules: Income at or below 250% of poverty, or TANF, Section 8, SNAP, SSI or General Assistance. Buildings of 14 or fewer units.

programs.name: Charge Up New Jersey
programs.rules: For a new eligible electric vehicle at an eligible dealer. Up to $250 more for a Level 2 home charger. Funds are limited.

programs.name: Successor Solar Incentive (SREC-II credits)
programs.rules: Paid on the power your system makes, not up front. Your solar contractor registers the project.

notes: We have not read the rebate tables of Elizabethtown Gas, New Jersey Natural Gas or South Jersey Gas, so they are not in this calculator.
Amounts are the most a program pays. Your rebate depends on the equipment, your final invoice and funds still available.
